answer.answer: The source provides several welfare measures for transgender persons, including: (1) Social protection schemes that must be made transgender inclusive [E01]; (2) Housing assistance schemes to help transgender people obtain non-discriminatory and safe housing [E01]; (3) A pension scheme for elderly transgender people regardless of gender assigned at birth [E01]; (4) An Umbrella Scheme with components including scholarships for transgender persons on the lines of SC student scholarships, loans with 25% subsidy for self-employment ventures, a pension scheme for transgender persons aged 40-60 years, and grant-in-aid to organizations providing vocational training [E02]; (5) Healthcare facilities with easy access through advisory to State Governments and Union Territory Administrations [E03]; (6) Coverage under Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojoja (RSBY) health insurance scheme [E03]; and (7) Special Self Help Group (SHG) status and relaxed rules/policies with subsidies and loans under the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM) [E03].

claim_to_evidence.claim: Social protection schemes must be made transgender inclusive
Housing assistance schemes should help transgender people obtain non-discriminatory and safe housing
A pension scheme is needed for elderly transgender people regardless of gender assigned at birth

An Umbrella Scheme should include scholarships for transgender persons on the lines of SC student scholarships, loans with 25% subsidy for self-employment ventures, a pension scheme for transgender persons aged 40-60 years, and grant-in-aid to organizations providing vocational training
Healthcare facilities should be made easily accessible to transgender persons through advisory to State Governments and Union Territory Administrations
Transgender persons should be covered under Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojoja (RSBY) health insurance scheme
Special Self Help Group (SHG) status should be granted to the transgender community with relaxed rules/policies, subsidies, and loans under the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM)
